text:
GENERATE BURST CS-near2-spire — ELONGATED NEAR-CAMERA ROCK SPIRE on green, for a foreground layer that must never show its base (Matt R-C3-87). task_id "CS-near2-spire".

IMAGE 1 is an approved in-game frame of a hand-painted 2D ARPG: the tall red-orange sandstone HOODOO on the right, rising out of a canyon of sunset clouds close to the camera, is the approved look (colours, banded eroded ledges, clinging dry shrubs, dark contours, warm sunset rim light on its upper-left edges, slightly darker and softer than the lit scene because it is near the camera).
Paint ONE PORTRAIT image 1024×1536 on flat PURE GREEN #00ff00 containing ONE such sandstone hoodoo, much TALLER than in IMAGE 1: a single tall, slightly leaning column of stacked, banded, eroded sandstone (a few overhanging ledges, a narrower neck near the top, a capstone), filling the full height of the image — its capstone top begins about 60–120 px below the top border and its body continues DOWN and is CUT FLUSH, straight and full-width by the BOTTOM border of the image (as if it continues far below the frame). Its width is about 380–520 px, centred horizontally. Same painted register, palette and light as IMAGE 1. Everything around it is flat pure #00ff00. No clouds, ground, sky, characters, text or border.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if the object's cut edge is not flush with the required image border, the object does not fill the required length, the background is not flat pure #00ff00, or the style clearly departs from IMAGE 1 — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/near2_spire.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-near2-spire"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — approved near-camera hoodoo look (style reference)
